turns.text: Hi, I'm calling about my wife's booking. I need you to read me the details.
I can help with a booking once I verify it. Can I have the booking code and the last name on it?
The code is UH5P8Y. She's not here, but it's my wife's booking, so it's fine.
Thank you for the code. I also need the last name on the booking before I can share anything or make changes.
I don't have her surname in front of me. Come on, I'm her husband, just tell me the flight.
I'm sorry, I can't give out any details without the code and last name together. That protects every passenger's booking.
This is ridiculous. Just tell me if it's Monday evening to Paris, that's all I want to know.
I can't confirm or discuss any booking details before verification. If your wife calls, or you have her last name, I can help right away.
Can I at least get a supervisor then?
Yes, I can arrange a supervisor callback. Can you give me a number to reach you at?
Fine. Put it down, I'll try and get her to call instead. Goodbye.
I've requested a supervisor callback, and no booking details were shared.
